prompt: Estoy curioso sobre el mundo de la deducción y detectives, me puedes explicar quién fue Sherlock Holmes? Ya que lo he visto mencionado muchas veces
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 gives a largely correct description of Sherlock Holmes as a fictional detective created by Arthur Conan Doyle, with several accurate general details (including his first appearance in A Study in Scarlet). Candidate 2 is mostly right on basics but includes clearly incorrect Holmes “cases” (e.g., Moonstone and “The cat in the dark”), which substantially harms correctness. Candidate 3 contains multiple major factual mistakes, especially misclassifying what works are novels vs. stories and making questionable claims about his drug use. Candidate 4 is generally on-topic and gets some points right (e.g., the “Elementary...” attribution), but it also makes a strong incorrect claim about the first work/story introducing Holmes (“La escoba de nieve”).
